name: IPython_display_import
description: Imports the Image and display functions from the IPython.display module for rendering images in Jupyter notebooks.

name: display_function_call
description: Calls the display function to render an image generated by the compiled_authoring_graph's draw_mermaid_png method, which visualizes the document writing state graph.
full_code:
display(
    Image(
        compiled_authoring_graph.get_graph().draw_mermaid_png(
            curve_style=CurveStyle.LINEAR,
            node_colors=NodeStyles(first="#ffdfba", last="#baffc9", default="#fad7de"),
            wrap_label_n_words=9,
            output_file_path=None,
            draw_method=MermaidDrawMethod.PYPPETEER,
            background_color="white",
            padding=10,
        )
    )
)

name: Image_function_call
